name: Power Amplifier - Ballistics
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized power supply unit that can be attached to an ST to raise its load limit. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Ballistics capability.

61002.name: Power Boost III · Ballistics
61002.SpecificEffects:
ST gains an extra <color=#F74848>300</color> Power.
When engaging in combat with a target at Ideal Range, gain DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
